purpose: Read-only FP8 parameter-gather screening against the current selected recipe.

scope.method: Perfetto MCP SQL on canonical normalized trace; count and duration aggregate GPU all-gather kernels.

derived_screen.basis: Largest 525336576-element buffers match the separate embedding and output-head matrices, both outside selected FP8 modules. Every observed gather has group size 8. This is a gathered-output byte-volume comparison, not a measured link traffic counter.
derived_screen.limits: Very generous upper screen: assumes all remaining weight data can halve; ignores BF16 parameters inside mixed buckets, scales, padding, extra collectives and conversion costs. Does not imply a kernel- or step-time reduction.

dense_vendor_quantization.limits: Only named standalone vendor weight-quantization kernels. Excludes fused/compiler kernels and expert quantization, and is not an elapsed-time savings estimate.

query: SELECT EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.dtype') dtype,EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.In msg nelems') input_elements,EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.Out msg nelems') output_elements,count(*) n,round(sum(dur)/1e6,3) kernel_ms FROM slice WHERE category='kernel' AND EXTRACT_ARG(arg_set_id,'args.Collective name')='_allgather_base' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY output_elements DESC
limits: Source/config/runner bytes unchanged; no GPU experiments or benchmark were run.
